audience: managers who schedule staff and approve leave in RotaCloud

useCases.title: See who works when and where
useCases.text: The AI lists rota shifts for a time range, filtered by location, role or user, and shows open shifts. You get a plain view of who is working and which shifts have no one.

useCases.title: Check who is clocked in and who is late
useCases.text: The AI reads who is clocked in right now, with location, role, minutes late and break state. It can also check past attendance records for a time range.

useCases.title: Handle leave requests
useCases.text: The AI lists leave requests that wait for a decision and reads the dates, leave type and employee message. It can approve or deny a request when you say so.

useCases.title: Create and publish shifts
useCases.text: The AI creates shifts with times, location and role, assigned or open, then publishes them so employees see them. It checks availability and days off first.

useCases.title: Clean up short open shifts
useCases.text: The AI finds open shifts shorter than a set time, shows a preview, and deletes them only after you confirm. Assigned shifts can be skipped.

useCases.title: Review payroll for a pay period
useCases.text: The AI reads payroll per employee for a pay period: attendance worked, paid and unpaid leave, overtime and pay totals. It sums up the period for you.
